freeGlobals.none: these functions read no free global; hdGenesFor (which reads _earthArt) is not called

terran.f: meadows, forests and slow rivers under a kind sun
gold grass to the horizon, herds moving like weather
canopy over canopy — the ground is a rumor
reed flats and braided channels, loud with small lives
tangled roots walking out into a warm sea
permafrost moss and a low, reluctant sun
sinkholes and cave mouths — the ground is hollow
blinding white pans where the water used to be
spore towers and gill canopies — a forest with no trees
mineral spires standing in the grass like a frozen chord

ocean.f: water to every horizon, weather its only geography
island chains scattered like a flung handful of green
turquoise reef flats you can read from orbit
squall lines stacked to the edge of sight
young fire building new land out of the sea
no islands, no shallows — a lightless deep that goes down and down
bioluminescent blooms wide enough to glow at the horizon

ice.f: rivers of old ice grinding to a frozen sea
a frozen ocean ridged where the floes shoulder each other
plumes of buried sea breaking through the crust
canyons of old blue ice, lit from within

desert.f: sand in slow waves the size of hills
slot canyons and strata — a history book split open
mirage shimmer over crusted brine pans
rust plains walked by dust devils
sand fused to glass by old lightning, sharp as a warning

rocky.f: a face that remembers every impact
regolith plains strewn with stones the size of houses
the crust pulled apart into long shadowed trenches
gashes of amethyst where the ground split and grew jewels
graphite-black plains that glint, here and there, like diamond

venus.f: storm decks of sulfur, gold-green and furious
a crushing haze that eats light and metal alike
the bottom of an atmosphere like an ocean — gloom, heat, and lightning

lava.f: cooling fields under a slow gray snowfall of ash
ground that glows through its own cracks
black glass plains veined with fire
a shoreline where the ocean is molten rock

gas.f: storm bands running unbroken around the world
one storm older than nations, wider than worlds
a giant that glows its own sullen red — the night side is a furnace

RING_SPECTRUM.note: the full spectrum — where Transcendent worlds are least rare
